verdict.rationale: Bolna is a telephony voice-agent platform, so DTMF, IVR navigation and voicemail handling are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions sending keypresses, navigating IVR menus, or detecting or leaving voicemail. The generic ready-to-use tools and SIP trunking items describe other features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can send DTMF keypresses, navigate IVR menus, and detect or leave voicemail
